action.text: Finding, not a verdict: the bite-sized card carries the nuance when its quote is the writer's own passage and the dated thread holds his thinking. Structure (papers) and attribution (HN, Reddit comments) must come from the source one tap away; HN extraction loses both today and the 20,000-character cap cuts long transcripts. A→B recommended with: More opens the source at the passage, quotes keep speaker and deep link, More hidden when nothing is behind the card. Full report: REPORT.md. Storage format change is KI-40.
